pulse.text: return true when the previous action turns to true only for the duration specified: 'is_using 'equalizer' & pulse 2000ms'

quantize_loop.text: when quantize_loop is on, loops automatically align according to the globalQuantize setting

quantize_setcue.text: when quantize_setcue is on, setting cues automatically align according to the globalQuantize setting

quick_filter.text: Apply or remove a quick filter on the list of song shown in the browser

rack.text: Open/close a unit in specified rack. Example: "rack 'rack1' 'unit1'"

rack_prioritize.text: Prioritizes a unit of the specified rack. When more configurations with same size are available, the prioritized unit will get most space. Example: "rack_prioritize 'rack1' 'unit1'"

rack_solo.text: Open/close a unit in full size on the specified rack. Closing the unit will re-open the previous configuration. Example: "rack_solo 'rack1' 'unit1'"

rane_motor_enable.text: Sent from controller to software to indicate hardware state of motor. While off, the controller ignores motor commands

rane_timecode.text: Activate timecode from the timecode input with the same index as the controller it's called from and deactivate timecode inputs from the same input on other decks

rane_timecode_enable.text: Set timecode mode for this deck to midi-controlled play-state

rating.text: Get or set the rating for the current song

reanalyze.text:
reanalyze bpm etc... for the file loaded on the deck
'reanalyze fluid' can be used to force a scan using fluid grid

record_cut.text: cut the current recording to a new file (or new track if recording to CD)

record_vu.text: show the volume of what's being recorded

recurse_folder.text: display the content of both the selected folder and all its subfolders in the browser list.

refresh_controller.text: refresh the display of the specified controller (or all if none specified).

reinit_controller.text: Reinit the specified controller (or all if none specified), going through the exit and init sequences (you can specify a delay between exit and init: "reinit_controllers 'mycontroller' 200ms".

relay_play.text: Enable or disable the decks to automatically start playing when the opposite deck reached its end

reloop_exit.text: if in loop, remove the loop. otherwise, reactivate the last used loop. Highlights when a loop had been used

repeat.text: repeat the actions every x ms as long as the key is pressed: 'repeat 1000ms & browser_scroll +1' (default is 500ms if no speed is specified. Second parameter can specify a delay before repeating the first time)

repeat_song.text: When active, song will restart from beginning when finished

repeat_start.text:
Repeat an action at a specified interval: 'repeat_start 'myrepeatname' 1000ms 5 & browser_scroll +1' (first parameter is an identifier name, second parameter is the interval and the third optional parameter can specify a number of times to repeat). The first action will be performed after an interval has passed.
The interval can be specified in milliseconds, beats, or can be an action of itself. 'repeat_start 'myrepeatname' 1bt' or 'repeat_start 'myrepeatname `get_var a`'

repeat_start_fade.text:
Fade from one value to another in a specified time and optionally in a specified number of steps: 'repeat_start_fade 'myfadename' 0.0 1.0 1000ms 4 1.0 & level'
First parameter is name, so it can be stopped early using repeat_stop. Second parameter is start value, third parameter is end value, fourth parameter is time (milliseconds or beats), fifth parameter is number of steps (optional, default is smooth).  Sixth parameter is curve (optional)
The action will be executed with the current value as a implicit parameter.
All parameters except name can be script as well by using backticks. For example: 'repeat_start_fade 'myfadename' `level` `get_var targetLevel` 1000ms 4 & level'. In this example, by using level as starting value, it will start to fade from the current value.

repeat_start_instant.text: Repeat an action at a specified interval: 'repeat_start_instant 'myrepeatname' 1000ms 5 & browser_scroll +1' (first parameter is an identifier name, second parameter is the interval and the third optional parameter can specify a number of times to repeat). The first action will be performed immediately.

repeat_stop.text: stop a previous repeat_start or repeat_start_instant action: 'repeat_stop 'myrepeatname''

rightcross.text: assign this deck to the right of the crossfader: "deck 3 rightcross"

rightdeck.text: select this deck to be the right deck: "deck 3 rightdeck" or "rightdeck +1"

rightvideo.text: assign this deck to the right of the video crossfader: "deck 3 rightvideo" or "rightvideo +1" or "rightvideo 'auto'".

rightvideo_button.text: simple button to control the right video source: "deck 3 rightvideo_button".

sampler_abort_rec.text: cancel the recording and delete the sample file

sampler_assign.text: 'sampler_assign 1 "path to vdjsample"' adds the sample to sample slot 1. (For use in drag&drop in pad page)

sampler_bank.text: Select a new sampler bank. Can be called either by name (sampler_bank "birthday"), by number (sampler_bank 2) or can be assigned to a rotary knob (sampler_bank) or buttons (sampler_bank +1)

sampler_color.text:
get the color of the sample on this slot if it has one
The sample number takes the sampler_pad_page into account, so should be used in combination with sampler_pad

sampler_edit.text: edit the given sample in the SampleEditor

sampler_group_color.text: get the color of a sampler group

sampler_group_mute.text: mute/unmute a sample group. You can specify the group by name, or by group index

sampler_group_name.text: get the name of a sampler group

sampler_group_volume.text: change the volume of all the samples in the give group. You can specify the group by name, or by group index

sampler_has_group.text: returns true if the specified group (specified by name or by index) exists in the current samplebank

sampler_inputgain.text: set the gain of the hardware sampler input

sampler_load_to_deck.text: Load the sample from the selected slot to the deck

sampler_loaded.text: 'sampler_loaded 1' returns true when there is a sample loaded in slot 1, otherwise returns false

sampler_loop.text:
use 'sampler_loop -1' or 'sampler_loop +1' to change the length of a playing sample
use 'sampler_loop "current" 1' to set the sample to loop for 1 beat or 'sampler_loop 1 1' to set sample 1 to 1 beat loop
use 'sampler_loop "current" 0.5 "play" while_pressed' to loop the sample as long as long as the button is pressed for 0.5 beats

sampler_mode.text:
set the global trigger mode for the sampler: "sampler_mode 'on/off'", 'hold', 'stutter' or 'unmute'
set trigger mode for a specific sample: "sampler_mode 1 'on/off'" to set sample 1 mode or "sampler_mode 1 +1" to cycle

sampler_options.text:
popup the sample menu.
can also be used with 'sampler_options "locked"' or 'sampler_options "stemswap"' to change the bank's settings.

sampler_output.text: Select sampler output channel. 'deck master sampler_output', 'sampler_output "headphones"', 'deck 1 sampler_output', 'sampler_output "popup"'

sampler_pad.text: 'sampler_pad 1' triggers the sample in slot 1, based on the play mode for that sample slot

sampler_pad_page.text: show next page of samples if the bank has more than 8 samples

sampler_pad_shift.text: 'sampler_pad_shift 1' stop sample when playing, delete sample otherwise

sampler_pad_volume.text:
'sampler_pad_volume 1' sets the volume of the sample on the first pad
'sampler_pad_volume "siren"' sets the volume of the sample 'siren.vdjsample'.
quoted_phrases: sets the volume of the sample

sampler_pfl.text: Select if the sampler is sent to the headphones. (can be used with a slider or a % to specify the volume: 'sampler_pfl 75%')

sampler_play.text:
play the selected sample. syntax 'sampler_play' plays the default sample. 
'sampler_play 4' plays the fourth sample.

sampler_play_stop.text: play the selected sample if it's not already playing, or stop it if it's already playing.

sampler_play_stutter.text: play the selected sample. if already playing, restart from begining.

sampler_position.text: get the current position of the sample

sampler_rec.text:
On first press, start to record a new sample. On second press, stop to record
Use 'sampler_rec "mic"' to record a sample from microphone, or 'sampler_rec "master"' to record from master output
If the deck is on loop, a loop sample will immediately be created. If the deck is playing, it will record what's playing until the stop. If the deck is paused, it sets the 'entry point', and the second push will set the 'exit point' and use the deck's file between those two points.
'sampler_rec 1' or 'sampler_rec 1 "mic"' will store the sample in the first slot of the "Record" sample bank, so that it can be used immediately after recording

sampler_rec_delete.text:
delete a recording from the "Recordings" bank
"sampler_rec_delete 3" would delete the sample previously recorded using "sampler_rec 3"

sampler_select.text: select which sample is the default sampler slot for that deck. syntax 'sampler select 5' selects the fifth sampler slot. 'sampler select +1' scrolls through the sampler slots. 'sampler select' open a popup menu to select the new default sampler slot.

sampler_start_rec.text: start to record (from the deck, or from mic or master if specified) in order to create a new sample file

sampler_stop.text: stop the selected sample. syntax 'sampler_stop' stops the default sample. 'sampler_stop 4' stops the fourth sampler slot. 'sampler_stop all' stops all samples.

sampler_stop_rec.text: stop the recording and save the result in a sample file

sampler_used.text: check if a sample is playing (or if used with 'sampler_used 4' check if exactly 4 samples are playing)

sampler_volume.text:
'sampler_volume' sets the volume of the sample that has the focus, on the selected deck.
'sampler_volume 1' sets the volume of the sample in slot 1 in the current bank.
'sampler_volume "siren"' sets the volume of the sample 'siren.vdjsample'.
quoted_phrases: sets the volume of the sample

sampler_volume_master.text: 'sampler_volume_master' sets the master volume of the sampler

sampler_volume_nogroup.text: sets the volume of the sample without changing the volume of other samples in the same group

sandbox.text:
activate/deactivate sandbox mode.
in sandbox mode, the master output continues to play what it was playing without being affected by your actions, and you can move both decks to whatever position you want, in order to prelisten your upcomming mix.

save_config.text: save your config changes now (usually changes are saved automatically when you close virtualdj)

save_deck_set.text: Save the current configuration (which song is loaded on which deck) in a file

saved_loop.text:
'saved_loop 1' Load the saved loop in slot 1 or set if it doesn't exist
'saved_loop "myloop"' Load saved loop named "myloop" or set if it doesn't exist

saved_loop_autotrigger.text: 'saved_loop_autotrigger 1' Activate/Deactivate auto-trigger of loop when the play position arrives at the saved loop

saved_loop_display.text:
Show information about a saved loop based on the savedLoopDisplay config option.
Example: 'saved_loop_display 1'
Can also be used to modify the savedLoopDisplay option by using +1 or -1 as parameter: 'saved_loop_display +1'

saved_loop_prepare.text:
'saved_loop_prepare 1' Activate/Deactivate the saved loop in slot 1 without jumping to the start point or set if it doesn't exist
'saved_loop_prepare "myloop"' Activate/Deactivate stored loop named "myloop" without jumping to the start point or set if it doesn't exist

scratch_dna.text: execute a scratch defined by its DNA signature (see scratch_dna_editor for information about DNA signatures)

scratch_dna_editor.text: open a visual editor to compose scratch DNA signatures

scratch_dna_option.text: set some options about the Scratch DNA behavior. options are "drymix" and "quantized"

scratchbank_unload.text: Unload the song previously loaded using scratchbank_load_to_deck from deck and load back the last song

search.text: put the keyboard focus on the search zone, or, if a text parameter is specified, search for this text.

search_add.text: add the specified text to the search query

search_delete.text: remove the last character from the search query

search_folder.text:
show or hide the searchbar for searching folders and lists
Use 'search_folder dialog' to open a separate dialog instead
Use 'search_folder clear' to clear the folder search
Use 'search_folder focus' to focus the folder search

search_folder_options.text: popup the list of search options for folders

search_options.text: popup the list of search options. to set one directly, you can use 'search_options "composer"' to toggle search of the field on or off

search_playlists.text:
open a dialog to search which list contains a specific song
by default it searches for the song selected in the browser. Use "search_playlists deck" to search for the song loaded on the deck.

seek.text: move into the song while the button is pressed. 'seek +2' moves beat by beat, skipping 2 beats every 10ms. 'seek +420ms' moves from 420ms every 10ms. using skip with a beat number keep the song playing correctly while moving inside.

select.text: select this deck as 'working deck'. the beat of the working deck will be shown in front in the display, and shortcuts and actions with no specified deck will affect this deck.\nUnless PFL has been set manually, the PFL will also follow the working deck.

select_master_output.text: Select if the audio should be played on the computer speakers or on the controller audio output

set.text:
set 'varname' 5		  sets variable varname to the value 5
set 'varname' 'var2'   sets variable varname to the value of variable var2
set 'varname' `play`  sets variable varname to the value of the action play

set_bpm.text: set the bpm of the song to the set value: 'set_bpm 129.3', or relative to the actual value: 'set_bpm 50%'.

set_browsed_file_bpm.text: set the bpm of the selected songs to the set value: 'set_bpm 129.3', or relative to the actual value: 'set_bpm 50%'

set_cue.text: store the current position in the cue. if one parameter is given, it's the number of the cue to use. if two parameters are given, the second is the position to store, in ms, in beats, or in percentage of the song length.

set_deck.text:
use script or implicit variable to affect which deck the action is applied to
example: 'set_deck `get_var varname` & play'

set_firstbeat.text: moves the first beat to the current position, adjusting the beat-grid

set_fluid.text: Switch between fluid and rigid grids

set_gain.text: set the gain in order to bring the song to the specified dBA (with 0dBA being the maximum level outputable by the soundcard without compression): 'set_gain 0'

set_key.text: change the key of the song to match the given key. you can use standard notation ('set_key "A#m"') or numeric ('set key "03A"'). if no given key, it will use the other deck. the change will match the exact key.

set_loadpoint.text: Set the point where the track will start when loaded

set_mixpoint.text:
Move the specified mix point to the current position ("StartTempo", "EndTempo", "StartCut", "EndCut", "StartFade", "EndFade", "StartSound", "EndSound")
Example: set_mixpoint "StartTempo"

set_var.text: set the value of the specified variable

set_var_dialog.text:
set_var_dialog 'varname'   opens a dialog to enter the value of varname
set_var_dialog 'varname' 'information text' opens a dialog to enter the value of varname, and shows the second parameter as informational text

setting.text:
read or write a specific setting (see config window for the list of all settings names)
Example: setting "jogSensitivityScratch" 80% 
Example: setting "videoRandomTransition" on

setting_reset.text: reset a setting to its default value

setting_setdefault.text: change the default value for a setting during this session

setting_setsession.text: force a specific value for a setting during this session

setting_setsession_deck.text: force a specific value for a setting during this session for a specific deck

shift.text: set or query the built-in shift variable, used for controllers

shift_all_cues.text: shift all the cues of the song from the given amount (can be used to fix the cues from v7 imported files in case the automatic fix didn't work properly): 'shift_all_cues -10ms'

shoutout.text: open a popup to easily create an audio sample from text without a microphone

show_pluginpage.text: show or hide the plugin control windows in the browser area

show_splitpanel.text:
Show/hide the specified split panel
Examples: "show_splitpanel 'sidelist'", "show_splitpanel 'sideview' on", "show_splitpanel 'sidelist' 50%"

show_text.text:
Show text on controller display. (If your controller uses get_display for the displays)
"show_text 'Line 1|Line 2' 3000ms" will show 2 lines of text for 3 seconds (time optional, | separates lines)
"show_text '$myvar$'" shows the contents of the variable $myvar

show_window.text: on skin with multiple windows, show or hide the specified window

sidelist_add.text: Add the songs selected in the browser to the sidelist

sidelist_load.text:
Load the folder or playlist selected in the browser in the sidelist
Use "sidelist_load 'append'" to add the selected folder to the sidelist instead of replacing the existing sidelist

sidelist_load_and_keep.text: load the first song from the sidelist.

sidelist_load_and_remove.text: load the first song from the sidelist, and remove it from the sidelist.

sidelist_options.text: display a drop-down with the list of options for the sidelist.

sidereco_options.text: Show a menu to select what should be displayed in the sideview recommendation panel

sideview.text:
Show a specific folder in the sideview. Available sideviews are automix,sidelist,karaoke,sampler,remixes,clone
Use 'sideview +1' or 'sideview -1' to scroll between available sideviews

sideview_options.text: show the context menu to add or remove folders shortcuts to the sideView

sideview_sort.text: Sort the sideview on the specified column: 'sideview_sort "artist"', 'sideview_sort "lastplay"',...

sideview_title.text: Show the title of the folder selected in sideview

sideview_triggerpad.text: set the sideview sampler in triggerpad mode or in list mode

silent_cue.text: Mute track when enabled until a hot cue is activated

skin_panel.text: show or hide a panel on the skin. "skin_panel 'my_panel' on"

skin_panelgroup.text: change which panel from a skin panel group is shown. syntax "skin_panelgroup 'groupname' 'panelname'" or "skin_panelgroup 'groupname' +1" or "skin_panelgroup 'groupname' 0.75"

skin_panelgroup_available.text: set a panel to be available or not. panels that are not available will not show up in group cycles

slicer.text:
"slicer 1" to "slicer 8" for 8 slicer buttons
"slicer 1 'hold'" to hold the current position on first activate
"slicer 'length' +1" to increase length
"slicer 'step' +1" to increase step size
"slicer video" to toggle video slicer on or off

slip.text: activate or deactivate a global slip mode, that will save the position on "slip on" and resume where it should have been if untouched on "slip off", letting you do any scratch/loop/effect/etc in between

slip_mode.text: While in slip mode, during loops hotcues or scratch, the play cursor will keep moving unaffected, and will resume from there after release

smart_cue.text: when smart_cue is on, songs are automatically re-synchronized when jumped to a new position or cue

smart_fader.text: When smart fader is activated, songs are synchronized while using the crossfader, and the tempo moves toward the tempo of the song that is being faded into

smart_loop.text: when smart_loop is on, loop are automatically adjusted to sound perfect

smart_play.text: when smart_play is on, songs are automatically synchronized when started

smart_scratch.text: when smart_scratch is on, backward scratching is automatically muted, only forward scratching will be heard

song_pos.text: position in the song. (the difference between song_pos and goto is that song_pos can be used as a slider).

songpos_remain.text: get the remaining time in %. if used with a parameter (in % or ms), returns true if the time left is less or equal than the value: 'songpos_remain 500ms ? blink'.

songpos_warning.text: returns true if the song is in its last 30s (actual time can be adjusted in options)

speedwheel.text: used for a precision touchwheel that reports both position and speed. 'speedwheel +1.0 1.5' means a full rotation of the wheel, at 150% speed.

startupspeed.text: vinyl startup speed, the larger, the longer it takes for the record to get from stopped to playing

stem.text:
Change the amount of a stem in the mix. Stem names are: "HiHat", "Vocal", "Instru", "Bass", "Kick", or you can use aggregate stems: "Melody" (Instru+Bass), "Rhythm" (HiHat+Kick), "MeloVocal" (Melody/Vocal), "MeloRhythm" (Melody/Rhythm).
To get kill on left side and isolate on right side of the slider, you can use "FullVocal", "FullMelo" and "FullRhythm"
To map a slider to always control the equalizer, regardless of EQ mode, you can use "stem FreqHi", "stem FreqMid", and "stem FreqLo"

stem_color.text: get the default color of a specific stem

stem_pad.text:
mute a stem (or isolate if pressed with Shift). Stem names are: "HiHat", "Vocal", "Instru", "Bass", "Kick", "Rhythm", "MeloRhythm", "Acapella", "Instrumental"
long press will work as temporary toggle. Second parameter can be "isolate" to isolate instead of mute ("stem_pad vocal isolate")

stem_volume.text:
change the amount of a stem in the mix. Stem names are: "HiHat", "Vocal", "Instru", "Bass", "Kick", or you can use aggregate stems: "Melody" (Instru+Bass), "Rhythm" (HiHat+Kick), "MeloVocal" (Melody/Vocal).
stem_volume has the max volume at 100% for use on sliders, whereas stem has defaults at 50%, and isolates above 50% for use on knobs

stems_bleed.text: Control how much the fast stems separation algorithm will allow bleeding. The action affects one of the four bleeding values (MuteVocal, MuteInstru, OnlyVocal, OnlyInstru) depending on what is currently muted or isolated on the deck. (NOTE: this does nothing on the regular HiQuality algorithm)

stems_split.text:
'stems_split' will duplicate deck 1 to deck 3 or deck 2 to 4, with the vocals playing on the first deck and the instruments on the other deck
'stems_split vocal target' will duplicate the opposite deck to the deck stems_split was called from

stems_split_unlink.text: After using stems_split, you can use stems_split_unlink to have the decks behave independently, allowing to scratch the vocals without affecting the instrumental for example

stop.text: stop to the last cue point, then on second press to the beginning of the song, then cycle through the cue points.

stop_button.text: depending on the play_mode, act like pause_stop (Numark way) or stop (Pioneer way).

switch_sidelist_playlist.text: Exchange the content of the automix list and the sidelist

sync.text: smoothly synchronize the song with the other deck.

sync_hint.text: sync_hint 'pitch' returns true if the pitch should be matched. Then sync_hint 'phase' returns true if the phase should be synced

system_volume.text: Change the system volume of the active sound card when available (use has_system_volume to check)

timecode_active.text:
Select if the deck is controlled by a timecode signal.
(note: You can use 'timecode_active x' where x is the turntable number, to assign the same turntable to control several decks at once: 'deck 1 timecode_active 1 on & deck 2 timecode_active 1 on')

timecode_bypass.text: Use the timecode turntable as linein input

timecode_cd_mode.text: Force timecode to CD mode (use when using a vinyl timecode on a cd or other digital device)

timecode_motor_enable.text: Hybrid turntables that send midi messages to indicate if motor is enabled can use this

timecode_pitch.text: For controllers that send the pitch through midi, let the timecode engine know the pitch slider's position

timecode_reset_pitch.text: Reset the "software" pitch to 100%, so that the deck pitch matches the turntable pitch exactly, and needle-drop is truly absolute

toggle.text: syntax: 'toggle "my_var"'. toggle my_var between true and false.

touchwheel.text: used for a jogwheel with touch sensitivity. 'touchwheel +1.0' means a full rotation of the wheel.

touchwheel_touch.text: use when the touchwheel is touched, to hold the song and start to scratch.

undo_load.text: Unload the song and reload the previous song. Use 'undo_load any' to unload from the last deck a song was loaded on. Otherwise the deck the action is called from is used.

unload.text: unload the song from the deck.

up.text: execute different actions depending if the key if pressed or released: 'up ? action1 : action2'

var.text:
'var "my_var" ? my_action1 : my_action2'. execute my_action1 if my_var is true (non zero), execute my_action2 otherwise.
You can also compare var with a specific value: 'var "my_var" 1 ? my_action1 : my_action2' execute my_action1 is my_var is 1, or my_action2 otherwise

var_equal.text:
syntax: 'var_equal "my_var" 42 ? my_action1 : my_action2'. execute my_action1 if my_var equals 42, execute my_action2 otherwise.
syntax: 'var_equal "this_var" "that_var" ? action1 : action2' execute action1 if this_var equals that_var, execute action2 otherwise

var_greater.text: syntax: 'var_greater "my_var" 42 ? my_action1 : my_action2'. execute my_action1 if my_var is greater than 42, execute my_action2 otherwise.

var_list.text: show a window with a list of your current variables and their values

var_not_equal.text: syntax: 'var_not_equal "my_var" 42 ? my_action1 : my_action2'. execute my_action1 if my_var doesn't equal 42, execute my_action2 otherwise.

var_smaller.text: syntax: 'var_smaller "my_var" 42 ? my_action1 : my_action2'. execute my_action1 if my_var is smaller than 42, execute my_action2 otherwise.

video.text: open or close the video window

video_crossfader_auto.text: move the video crossfader automatically according to which side is playing, cueing, scratching, etc...

video_crossfader_link.text: link or unlink the video crossfader to the audio crossfader

video_delay.text:
set a delay between video or audio to synchronize output (in milliseconds)
Use "video_delay +100ms" or "video_delay -100ms" to increase or decrease the delay, or "video_delay 0ms" to reset it
Use "video_delay +100" or "video_delay -100" to set it to exactly the specified amount

video_fx_button.text: push the n-th button of the video effect plugin

video_fx_clear.text: deactivate all the active video effects

video_fx_select.text: select a video effect plugin. you can specify by name ('video_fx_select "my_plugin"'), relative ('video_fx_select +1') or without parameters to open a popup window listing the available plugins

video_fx_slider.text: move the n-th slider of the video effect plugin

video_level.text: fade-to-black independent slider for the left or right video deck

video_output.text:
Show menu to select on which monitor to open the video output. 
You can also specify a specific output: "video_output 1" to open video output on the first monitor
To just show or hide the output use "video_output on" or "video_output off". To toggle output, use "video_output ? video_output off : video_output on"

video_source.text: activate video if not active yet, and open the shader selection dialog if visuals is the source

video_source_select.text: select the plugin used for video source. you can specify by name ('video_source_select "webcam"'), relative ('video_source_select +1') or without parameters to open a popup window listing the available plugins

video_transition.text:
Launch a transition from one video deck to the other.
You can specify the duration of the transition: 'video_transition 1000ms'
You can specify the direction of the transition: 'video_transition "left"' or 'video_transition "left" 1000ms'
You can specify the location to transition to using a percentage (or assign it to a slider): 'video_transition 50%' or 'video_transition 1000ms 50%'

video_transition_button.text: push the n-th button of the video transition plugin

video_transition_select.text: select the plugin used for video transitions. you can specify by name ('video_transition_select "my_plugin"'), relative ('video_transition_select +1') or without parameters to open a popup window listing the available plugins

video_transition_slider.text: move the n-th slider of the video transition plugin

view_options.text: popup the list of view options. to set one directly, you can use 'view_options "showkaraoke" on' etc...

vinyl_mode.text: Set the jogwheel to Vinyl mode (with scratch), or to CD mode (with pitchbend)

wait.text: wait for the specified amount of time between two script actions: 'wait 1bt & pause', 'wait 500ms & play'

wheel_mode.text: change the mode of the jogwheel between: "jog", "search", "loop_move", "loop_out", "loop_in", "browser", or use +1 and -1 to cycle through all modes. You can select from a subset using a syntax like 'wheel_mode "loop_move,loop_in,loop_out" +1'.

zoom.text: zoom horizontal rhythm and scratch visual
